character.name: Sera
character.starting_goal: preserve the decree discrepancy without accusing a person or exposing sources
starting_relationships: Archivist Lior trains Sera in evidence custody.
Councilor Vale publicly demands quick answers but has no privileged access by default.

world.habitat: dense canal city with registry offices, chamber galleries and water-gate districts
world.technology_level: sealed ledgers, legal decrees, handwritten duplicates and messenger routes
world.magic_level: none; all claims require documentary or witnessed evidence
world.summary: Rivergate allocates water through a public council decree and protected archives. Notaries distinguish clerical discrepancies from evidence of intentional revision. Private witness identities must not be exposed without formal authorization.
social_context: A sealed council document is not automatically public.
Policy disagreement is not proof of criminal intent.
known_pressures: Two signed decrees name different allocation gates.
A civic deadline makes premature conclusions politically costly.
